text: AI & Innovation Smart regulation of artificial intelligence that protects Alabamians while embracing innovation. Thoughtful policies that prepare Alabama for future jobs and economic opportunities. Learn More
CHOOSE Act Reform The CHOOSE Act needs fiscal guardrails to protect Alabama's education budget. Add spending caps and accountability measures to ensure public schools aren't left behind. Learn More
Career Training Access Alabama has world-class free training programs through AIDT and community colleges. Expand access so people can get high-paying jobs and build better futures. Learn More

Data Centers & Our Community Ensure data centers serve our communities with transparency and accountability. Protect Alabama's water, wildlife, and ratepayers from secret deals and unfair cost shifting. Technology should serve people, not the other way around. Learn More
Keep Rural Hospitals Open 27 Alabama hospitals are at risk of closing. We need rural hospital tax credits, telehealth expansion, and healthcare workforce recruitment—not empty promises. Learn More
Lower Power Bills Expand nuclear energy and explore solar options to increase clean power supply and drive costs down. Support advanced nuclear projects in the Tennessee Valley. Learn More

Modernize Schools Ensure every education dollar goes to preparing kids for 21st-century jobs, not maintaining a rigged tax system. Modernize schools so every child can thrive in a 21st-century economy. Learn More

Outdoor Heritage & Stewardship Alabama's $3.2 billion hunting and fishing economy supports 73,553 jobs. Protect our natural resources through voluntary partnerships with landowners, not Washington mandates. Stewardship that works for District 7. Learn More
Remove Job Barriers Alabama requires a $75 license just to wash hair. Cut unnecessary occupational licensing and let people earn a living. Support SB138's reforms and go further. Learn More
Second Chances People with past mistakes who've done their time deserve the chance to work and rebuild. Remove automatic job disqualifications for old, unrelated convictions. Learn More

Tax Reform & Fair Taxes Alabama's tax system is rigged against working families. Eliminate the grocery tax, close loopholes for the wealthy, and create a fair system where everyone pays their share. Learn More
